name: National Fuel Gas Company
subsector: Production et distribution de gaz naturel
tagline: Integrated natural gas producer, transporter, and distributor across the Appalachian Basin
hero_kpi_rationale: Les réserves prouvées totales de 4 981 Bcfe reflètent la base de ressources stratégique de la société et sa capacité de production à long terme dans le bassin des Appalaches

kpis.explanation: Annual quantity of natural gas produced by the Company
kpis.description: Natural gas production is a key operational indicator of the Company's upstream activities and ability to grow production from Marcellus and Utica shale operations

kpis.explanation: Total proved developed and undeveloped natural gas reserves held by the Company
kpis.signal: Reserve base grew 5% year-over-year demonstrating successful reserve replacement
kpis.description: Proved reserves of 4,981 Bcfe represent the Company's strategic resource base in the Appalachian Basin and underpin long-term production growth trajectory

stories_kpis.name_en: Acquisition of Vectren Energy Delivery of Ohio
stories_kpis.explanation: Strategic acquisition of regulated utility assets from CenterPoint Energy Resources Corp
stories_kpis.signal: Transformational acquisition announced October 20, 2025 with expected closing Q4 2026
stories_kpis.description: Acquisition of Vectren Energy Delivery for $2.62 billion (funded via $1.42B cash and $1.2B promissory note) doubles the Company's gas utility rate base, adds Ohio operations, and provides scale in a constructive regulatory environment. Closing expected Q4 calendar 2026 pending regulatory approvals.
